blockers.acceptance: 核对原创代码权属、贡献者及第三方依赖许可，确定发行许可并保留声明
确认去除企业许可目录后的构建与功能边界，完成派生代码及资产许可审查
与维护者当前基线核对差异，保留新增业务能力及升级记录
公共配置接入各运行时，移除实际执行路径中的实验室域名、固定身份、服务地址和绝对路径
blockers.scopeNote: Native core runtime and account/project service keys verified locally. Unported extensions, external integrations, branding portability and deployment remain open.

blockers.acceptance: 无飞书环境完成首个管理员初始化、邀请、登录、退出和跨应用身份映射；首次部署不依赖既有服务
blockers.scopeNote: Native initialization, invitation, account recovery, owner transfer, live revocation and directory sync verified on an empty local organization. Existing identity migration and deployment acceptance remain open.

blockers.acceptance: 可选模块关闭时，页面、API、MCP、定时任务和邮件消费全部停止；服务端执行限制
blockers.scopeNote: Selected built-in modules have HTTP/API/MCP/worker gates and data preservation. Local core data writers run while external AI/notification delivery stays disabled. Other extensions remain unported.

blockers.acceptance: 项目只创建一次，显式 ID 关联，改名归档和成员变化可恢复且不重复建空间
blockers.scopeNote: Stable project and space IDs, approval gating, concurrent/restart retries, milestone/link writes and live permissions verified locally. Full rename/archive/membership lifecycle and historical migration remain open.

blockers.acceptance: 独立依赖安装与锁文件校验通过，不使用原目录 node_modules、私有仓库认证或本机链接
blockers.scopeNote: Verified on this macOS machine using independent installs and lockfiles; clean Linux installation remains under deployment acceptance.

blockers.acceptance: 核心 Compose、初始化、健康检查、持久化路径和私有凭据初始化在干净环境通过
验证备份恢复、兼容升级、迁移失败处理，不默认用旧数据库覆盖新写入
两个真实测试账号完成项目、文档、需求和交付全流程及越权验证，无实验室服务请求或真实外发
blockers.scopeNote: Local project, requirement assignment/update/comment/acceptance and knowledge-document flow verified with two synthetic accounts; actual GitHub/AI delivery, attachments and external integrations not accepted.
